shortDescription: This module manages CIFS/SMB shares and NFS exports on Hitachi NAS servers

options.name: api_key
options.description: The REST API authentication key - the preferred authentication method.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the REST API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The URL to access the Hitachi NAS REST API.  This needs to include the protocol, address, port and API version.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the REST API.

options.name: data
options.description: Additional data to describe the CIFS/SMB share or NFS export. The I(name), I(virtualServerId) and I(type) parameters are required for all operations The other parameters are only required for I(present) operations Some parameters are applicable to NFS exports only Some parameters are applicable to CIFS/SMB shares only Some parameters are applicable to both NFS exports and CIFS/SMB shares.

options.name: state
options.description: If I(state=present), ensure the existence of a share/export, and that it is in the requested state/configuration, including CIFS/SMB share authentications. If I(state=absent), ensure that specific share/export is not present on the server. CIFS/SMB share authentications can also be removed (marked as absent) without removing the share.
